bren.name: Bren Alder
bren.biography: A Lantern Compact shieldbearer who brought everyone home from Cinder Watch except the captain who ordered them to stay.

abilities.name: Shield Rush
abilities.description: Closes on a threat and briefly stuns it.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.description: Protects an injured traveler and draws nearby threats.

barks.forest: There is room on the path for both of us.
barks.rain: Keep your shield over the tinder. The rest can dry.
barks.night: I will take the first watch.
barks.ruin: Look for a way out before a way in.
barks.camp: A roof is a promise someone intends to keep.
barks.town: Count the lit windows. That is what a watch is for.
barks.personal: I know this road. Give me a moment before we go on.
barks.story: A promise should leave people somewhere to stand.
barks.combat: Stay behind my shield. I can hold this space.

tarin.name: Tarin Fen
tarin.biography: An Elderbough pathfinder whose sister Lysa vanished from the Wardens’ rolls. He still marks the paths she taught him to read.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: Pins a rushing enemy with a slowing arrow.

abilities.name: Split Fletching
abilities.description: Fires at up to three nearby threats.

tarin.passive: Clear Passage · arrows pierce armor for 20% more damage

barks.forest: Someone bent that fern against the wind. We are not the first here.
barks.rain: Rain hides a trail. It does not erase the reason for taking it.
barks.night: Lysa taught me the stars. I taught her how to cheat at cards.
barks.ruin: Stone keeps footprints longer than people think.
barks.boss: Keep it looking at you. I only need a moment.
barks.camp: I left the gate wide enough for a tired horse.
barks.town: Every town has a path the map leaves out. Usually behind the bakery.
barks.personal: Lysa used to stop here. I thought I had forgotten.
barks.story: We have opened a road. Now we have to keep it open.
barks.combat: Keep them moving. I have a clear shot.

ilyra.name: Ilyra Venn
ilyra.biography: A Keeper of the Veil who copied a forbidden annotation before her teacher ordered the page burned. She wants evidence more than absolution.

abilities.name: Frost Bind
abilities.description: Slows a clustered group before it surrounds the party.

abilities.name: Ember Mark
abilities.description: Marks a dangerous foe with lingering fire.

ilyra.passive: Open Hand · spell cooldowns recover 20% faster

barks.forest: Roots cross without asking whose ground this is. Sensible of them.
barks.rain: Ink first. Hood second. There are priorities.
barks.night: That star was missing from the older charts.
barks.ruin: A warning and an instruction can share the same words.
barks.boss: It remembers an order. We can give it a reason to stop.
barks.camp: A shelf, a dry page, and no one burning either. Luxury.
barks.town: Someone here knows a story that never reached our shelves.
barks.personal: These are the stones I wrote to Orsa about.
barks.story: I have written down what we chose. In our own words this time.
barks.combat: Leave a little room. The next spell needs it.

sera.name: Sera Reed
sera.biography: A road healer who treated both sides of the ford dispute. Her old field ledger records who was turned away when medicine ran short.

abilities.name: Field Dressing
abilities.description: Restores the most injured ally nearby.

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.description: Clears harmful conditions and grants brief regeneration.

sera.passive: No One Turned Away · Field Dressing heals both allies

barks.forest: That plant helps a fever. The one beside it starts one.
barks.rain: Wet boots, then blisters, then complaints. We can prevent two of those.
barks.night: Wake me for a fever. Snoring is between you and your conscience.
barks.ruin: Leave a clean path back. Carrying someone changes the journey.
barks.boss: Still breathing? Good. We can work with that.
barks.camp: I put the medicine where sleepy people can find it.
barks.town: Clean water first. The rest of a town can wait a moment.
barks.personal: I remember the people before I remember the place.
barks.story: Tomorrow there will still be patients. Today we made room for them.
barks.combat: Stay where I can reach you.
